annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación, Tecnología y Telecomunicaciones (MICITT), Costa Rica
key_provisions_or_claims: Seven thematic axes including responsibility and ethics, territorial nodes, digital infrastructure, smart government, AI training, data security and privacy, and institutional climate and collaborative governance.
Sets guiding principles and a governance model for the strategy (ENIA-CR) with a five-phase process.
Situational analysis identifies low R&D investment, scarce AI talent and weak data governance.
Includes monitoring and evaluation plan and an annex mapping Costa Rican and international legal norms.
Highlights worker displacement, data protection and cybersecurity risks.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Costa Rica's draft National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (ENIA) by MICITT. It provides situational analysis, guiding principles, a governance model and seven axes of action (ethics, territorial nodes, infrastructure, smart government, training, data security/privacy, institutional climate), with monitoring and a legal norms annex. No robotics-specific provisions.
annotation.title_clean: Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial de Costa Rica (ENIA)
annotation.title_en: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy of Costa Rica (ENIA)
